title: Mechanism 1: DNS-published keys + RFC 9421 request signing (inbound verify, outbound sign)
description: Provisional format: <selector>._mimi.<domain> TXT v=MIMI1; k=ed25519; p=<base64>; keyid = selector; covered @method @target-uri content-digest created and From. hickory-resolver; DNSSEC not required, validation result logged. mimid signs all outbound peer requests. Needs mimid-75nk.2.
close_reason: Implemented (3ae7464, live check 1 commit later). Published mimid1._mimi.mimid.reviewcommit.com TXT "v=MIMI1; k=ed25519; p=81rGxBkc1CHNwC9YBCnbDWqSbA1/7zdA6L56QLk27kQ=" TTL 300 at Epik on 2026-11-15; Cloudflare DoH AD=true; mimid's resolver+parser find it secure. Not yet deployed to the host: needs dns_servers set there (AWS VPC resolver strips DNSSEC).
